title: Diagonal operators on Janson-Sobolev and Janson-Sobolev-Hardy spaces
summary: We study the Banach space and operator factorization structure of Janson-Sobolev and Janson-Sobolev-Hardy spaces. This new class of martingale spaces is determined by a $q$-adic filtration, a subspace $V\subset \mathbb{R}_0^{l\times q}$, and a rearrangement invariant function space $X$. Our main result shows that, for every bounded diagonal operator $D$, the operator $S = \sum_{t=1}^s λ_{\mathcal U}^{k_t}(D)Q_{\mathcal K_t}^{\mathcal B}$ determined by the linear functionals $λ_{\mathcal U}^{k_t}(D)$ and the canonical projections $Q_{\mathcal K_t}^{\mathcal B}$, almost projectionally factors…
